family_followups.topic: Capture-family animation argument and rate semantics
family_followups.finding: Audit normal-speed/no-blend claims in sibling entries. FreezeState can force speed zero; blend zero chooses resource metadata; ftAnim_SetAnimRate caches requests while x2223_b0 is set.
Initial CaptureKoopa setup also invokes these damage entries. Family descriptions should not limit entry provenance to repeat bites or assume victim_gobj always refers to a victim.

Foreign specialhi/walk member spellings need owner review rather than semantic propagation. Inclusive displacement comparisons and a <=0 timer test do not justify positive-only else descriptions in exceptional-float cases.
